name: Collection Notice Action Pack
tagline: Turns a scary collection letter into a deadline, a script and drafts
description: Paste in a collection notice and it converts the document into a work plan: the real reply deadline, a script that avoids admitting anything, draft dispute letters, and a checklist of the evidence worth gathering. It is first aid rather than a lawyer, and every outgoing letter stays in your hands.
author: AlexFCHF
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
